R31 executed the existing typed-wave footprint probe: raw point sampling RMSE was 0.0644793 against exact cell averages, while numerical quadrature matched the analytic sinc average at RMSE 0.00004546. R31 then inspected fixed Tiles Mother commit 95c97a9: its shader derives a footprint from dFdx/dFdy and applies band(fp,scale), but grain and micro paths apply the same gate during assignment and again in structuralHeight. No GPU/browser/iPhone or visual acceptance occurred; R1 and production Mothers remain unchanged.
